reader.decision: Approve rejecting retention_days: 0 in validate (change to < 1), but only after the other tenant configs are checked. Do not add the in-progress skip now.
reader.decision_reason: The message shows the schema accepts a value the docs forbid, and a one-line change closes the failure. The check of other tenants is the only open risk, and the message says only acme-labs.yaml exists in this repo.

reconstruction.problem: TenantConfig.validate only rejects retention_days < 0, so 0 passes. purge_tenant then sets cutoff = now, and any upload created before now, including one still in progress, satisfies created_at < cutoff.
reconstruction.what_breaks: purge-worker deleted in-progress multipart uploads for acme-labs. An upload started at 10:00 was deleted at 10:15 although it can run up to 6 hours.
reconstruction.fix: Change validate to raise ValueError when retention_days < 1, with the message 'retention_days must be >= 1'. The acme-labs owner then picks a value of 1 or more. The alternative is for purge_tenant to skip uploads that have not completed.
reconstruction.cost: The primary fix changes one line. Any tenant file that sets 0 will fail to load, and acme-labs.yaml needs a new value from its owner. Tenants outside this repo may also set 0. The alternative needs a status field on upload, which is not confirmed to exist because store is outside this repo.

follow_up_questions: Do tenant configs live outside this repo, such as a deployed or other repo, that might set retention_days: 0 and would fail to load after the change?
What should the acme-labs retention_days value be, and who owns that decision?
reader.closing_answer: Yes, I approve rejecting retention_days: 0 in validate. Before merging, I check for tenant configs outside this repo that set 0. The acme-labs value is for its owner to choose, at least 1.
